The '''Globe of Peace''' was a relic of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo people]]. It resembled a small sphere which glowed with an iridescent light and symbolized the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of peace that reigned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. As a gesture of good faith and continued relations with the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] people, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] [[Freedom of Naboo/Legends|presented]] the globe to [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]].
